mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% over a three-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% over three months, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis recovery regimes, a declining federal funds rate signals continued monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of post-crisis recovery periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive year-over-year growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, a rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early-cycle expansion periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
